---
title: "Buffy"
output:
  html_document:
    css: styles.css
    theme: flatly
---

```{r slideshow, echo=FALSE}
library(htmltools)

photos <- list.files("buffy_photos",
                     pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|JPG|JPEG|PNG|GIF)$",
                     full.names = FALSE)

if (length(photos) == 0) {
  HTML('<p style="text-align:center; margin-top:3em; color:#8b5e5e;">
         No photos found — add images to the <code>buffy_photos/</code> folder and re-render.
       </p>')
} else {
  js <- sprintf('
(function() {
  var current = 0;
  var total = %d;
  var timer;
  function show(n) {
    var slides = document.querySelectorAll(".buffy-slide");
    var dots   = document.querySelectorAll(".buffy-dot");
    slides[current].classList.remove("active");
    dots[current].classList.remove("active");
    current = ((n %% total) + total) %% total;
    slides[current].classList.add("active");
    dots[current].classList.add("active");
  }
  function auto() { timer = setTimeout(function() { show(current + 1); auto(); }, 3000); }
  window.buffyNext = function() { clearTimeout(timer); show(current + 1); auto(); };
  window.buffyPrev = function() { clearTimeout(timer); show(current - 1); auto(); };
  window.buffyGoTo = function(n) { clearTimeout(timer); show(n); auto(); };
  auto();
})();
', length(photos))

  tagList(
    div(class = "buffy-outer",
      div(class = "buffy-container", id = "buffyContainer",
        lapply(seq_along(photos), function(i) {
          tags$img(
            src   = paste0("buffy_photos/", photos[i]),
            class = if (i == 1) "buffy-slide active" else "buffy-slide",
            alt   = paste("Buffy photo", i)
          )
        })
      ),
      tags$button(class = "buffy-btn buffy-prev", onclick = "buffyPrev()",
                  HTML("&#10094;")),
      tags$button(class = "buffy-btn buffy-next", onclick = "buffyNext()",
                  HTML("&#10095;")),
      div(class = "buffy-dots",
        lapply(seq_along(photos), function(i) {
          tags$span(
            class   = if (i == 1) "buffy-dot active" else "buffy-dot",
            onclick = paste0("buffyGoTo(", i - 1, ")")
          )
        })
      )
    ),
    tags$script(HTML(js))
  )
}
```
